persona.label: Unclear and disorganised
persona.description: Hard to interview. Rambles, misreads questions, needs the frequency scale re-explained, discloses out of order. Tests whether the agent can actively guide rather than merely transcribe.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: What is your full legal name as it appears on your legal documents?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: Oh—right, my name is Eleanor Haywood.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: How would you like your gender recorded?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: Female.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: What is your date of birth? You may use DD/MM/YYYY or a written date.

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: It’s 26 April 1981.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: Please repeat your date of birth in DD/MM/YYYY format.

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: Sorry, do you mean the numbers only? I’m getting myself a bit muddled—there’s the day, then the month, then the year, and I’ve already said it in words. Could you ask it again, maybe a different way?

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: What is your full home address, including street address, city, and province?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: 155 Balliol Street… in Toronto, Ontario.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: What is your Canadian postal code?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: M4S1C4.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: Please repeat the postal code using letters and numbers.

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: M4S 1C4.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: What is your email address?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: Oh, um… I’m not sure if you mean the one I actually use, or the contact one they have on file? I can usually find it if I look, but off the top of my head I’m a bit mixed up. Could you ask again?

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: Please repeat your email address.

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: eleanor.haywood@example.com

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: What is your phone number, including area code?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: Um—sorry, is that the home number, or the main contact number? I’m a bit tangled up. I know it’s the one with the 416 area code, but I’m not quite following what format you want. Could you say it again?

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: Please repeat your 10-digit phone number.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: Do you currently have a family doctor?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: I think so, but I’m not fully sure what you mean by family doctor versus the person I usually see… maybe Dr. Susan Chen? Or is this just whether I have someone listed? Could you ask that another way?

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: Please answer yes or no.

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: Yes.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: What is your family doctor's full first and last name?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: Dr. Susan Chen.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: Do you currently have a psychiatrist?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: No.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: What main problems or difficulties have you been experiencing lately?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: It’s been this heavy, low mood for years, honestly, and I keep getting stuck on this fear that I’m going to end up like my father did… he died by suicide when I was twelve, and it sort of sits there in my head. I feel really down a lot of the time, and I don’t feel good about myself. But I’m not thinking about doing anything to myself.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: What do you hope to get out of your appointment?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: I just want to stop feeling like my father’s death is my future. And, I guess… break that pattern for my own daughter.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: Have you ever been assessed by a mental health professional?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: Yes, I was assessed back in 2019 by my family physician for the long-standing low mood.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: When were you assessed, and by whom?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: In 2019, by my family physician.

conversation.speaker: CIRA

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: Yes—persistent depressive disorder.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: Have you ever been admitted to a hospital for mental health reasons?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: No.

conversation.speaker: CIRA

conversation.speaker: PATIENT

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: Have you previously received CBT, DBT, interpersonal therapy, mindfulness-based therapy, psychodynamic therapy, or another therapy?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: Yes, I had psychodynamic psychotherapy. It was… 2020 to 2022, I think, and there were about 60 sessions, in private practice.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: When did you receive that therapy?

conversation.speaker: CIRA

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: About 60 sessions.

conversation.speaker: PATIENT

conversation.speaker: PATIENT

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: 100 mg each morning.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: When did you start it, or approximately how long have you taken it?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: I started it in 2019.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: What side effects have you experienced, if any?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: No known side effects.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: Are you taking any other prescribed medications? If yes, please give the medication name.

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: No, that’s the only one.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: Have you previously tried any psychiatric medications?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: No, I haven’t.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: Have you ever been diagnosed with any medical conditions?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: No medical conditions that I know of.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: Have you ever had any surgical procedures?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: No.

conversation.message: What is your height? You may answer in centimetres or feet and inches.

conversation.speaker: PATIENT

conversation.speaker: PATIENT

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: Yes. My father had depression… and my paternal grandmother did too, I think. But my father died by suicide when I was twelve.

conversation.speaker: PATIENT

conversation.message: Depression.

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: He died by suicide in 1993.

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: Yes, my paternal grandmother.

conversation.speaker: CIRA

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: Depression.

conversation.speaker: CIRA

conversation.speaker: PATIENT

conversation.speaker: CIRA

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: No, those are all.
